dialogue.speaker: Budi
dialogue.text: Para penumpang penerbangan 304, dengan menyesal kami sampaikan bahwa penerbangan Anda dibatalkan.
dialogue.en: Passengers for flight 304, I am sorry to say your flight has been cancelled.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Permisi, apa yang terjadi? Saya punya koneksi penting nanti.
dialogue.en: Excuse me, what happened? I have an important connection later today.

dialogue.speaker: Budi
dialogue.text: Ada masalah teknis pada pesawat. Kami mohon maaf atas keterlambatan ini.
dialogue.en: There was a technical problem with the plane. We apologize for the delay.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Bisakah Anda menjadwal ulang saya ke penerbangan lain hari ini?
dialogue.en: Can you rebook me on another flight today?

dialogue.speaker: Budi
dialogue.text: Ada penerbangan pukul delapan malam ini. Biar saya periksa apakah masih ada kursi.
dialogue.en: There is a flight at eight tonight. Let me check if there are seats.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Tolong periksa. Kalau tidak ada, apa pilihan saya?
dialogue.en: Please do. If not, what are my options?

dialogue.speaker: Budi
dialogue.text: Kami bisa menawarkan hotel dan penerbangan besok pagi.
dialogue.en: We can offer you a hotel and a flight tomorrow morning.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Saya lebih suka berangkat malam ini. Apakah ada kompensasi atas ketidaknyamanan ini?
dialogue.en: I would prefer to travel tonight. Is there compensation for the inconvenience?

dialogue.speaker: Budi
dialogue.text: Ya, Anda berhak mendapat kompensasi, dan saya akan memberi Anda formulirnya.
dialogue.en: Yes, you have the right to compensation, and I will give you the form.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Terima kasih. Apakah saya juga mendapat voucher makan?
dialogue.en: Thank you. Do I also receive a meal voucher?

dialogue.speaker: Budi
dialogue.text: Ya, ini voucher untuk restoran. Anda ada di penerbangan pukul delapan.
dialogue.en: Yes, here is a voucher for the restaurant. You are on the eight o'clock flight.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Bagus, itu menyelesaikan masalah saya. Saya sangat menghargai bantuan Anda.
dialogue.en: Great, that solves my problem. I really appreciate your help.
